1.title: Trump Switched to Old Air Force One at NATO Summit After Credible Iranian Threat
1.summary: The threat led the Secret Service to urge President Trump to fly out of Turkey on the old plane, raising questions about the security of the Qatari-donated jet.

2.title: Wisconsin officials open investigation into fatal police shooting
2.summary: Corey Ruiz, 38, was shot and killed on Wednesday in an altercation with four officers. Police say he resisted arrest and pulled a knife during the incident.

3.title: Cornell, Northwestern and Other Universities Plan for Classes at Middle East Campuses
3.summary: Even after the collapse of the cease-fire between the United States and Iran, American universities expect to teach in Qatar and the United Arab Emirates, and a new outpost is on track to open in Saudi Arabia.

4.title: Firefighters struggle to contain Madrid wildfires, as more than 140,000 evacuated in France and Spain
4.summary: Authorities face the "worst fire in the history of the region", Madrid officials say, as French firefighters battle a blaze heading towards Bordeaux.

5.title: Iran War Live Updates: Trump Meets With Cabinet Over Whether to Intensify Iran Strikes
5.summary: The discussions at the White House came days before a planned meeting with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel.  Across the region, Iran and the United States continued to trade attacks.

6.title: ICC top prosecutor removed over sexual misconduct allegations
6.summary: Karim Khan denies allegations of engaging in an improper sexual relationship with a junior ICC staff member and seeking to stop her pursuing her complaint.
